Create a topology-aware rule

Source: R/topology_classes.R
new_rule.Rd

Create a topology-aware rule

Usage

new_rule(
  id,
  title,
  topology,
  scope,
  intent,
  domain = "",
  domains = character(),
  severity = "warning",
  owner_team = "Biostats",
  identity_spec = NULL,
  match_spec = NULL,
  delta_spec = NULL,
  fn
)

Arguments

id

Rule ID.

title

Rule title.

topology

Topology tag (A0-A7).

scope

Scope tag.

intent

Intent tag.

domain

Optional primary domain.

domains

Optional multi-domain set.

severity

Severity label.

owner_team

Owner team label.

identity_spec

Optional identity spec.

match_spec

Optional match spec.

delta_spec

Optional delta spec.

fn

Evaluation function.

Value

A validated CoreRule object.
